****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84867&L=38525&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9NRzVRZ3Y1VThvVT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWFjdGlvbithbGVydCZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=06c8b7b23dfa7be76d4b38e56b4c87a2d72dae5c813ed167a494fbdf3811d420)******
****Christina Bobb is a senior attorney for Judicial Watch focused on national security law. She began her legal career in the United States Marine Corps, where she defended Marines and Sailors in courts-martial and administrative separation hearings. Ms. Bobb served multiple overseas tours, including Helmand Province, Afghanistan, and Stuttgart, Germany. After her military service, she transitioned to private practice at Higgs, Fletcher, & Mack LLP in San Diego, and then to Washington, DC, where she held executive-level positions within the Department of Homeland Security. Christina served as attorney for President Donald J. Trump from 2022-2024, when she transitioned to the Republican National Committee to assist election integrity efforts for the 2024 election. In 2023, Ms. Bobb authored her first book, “Stealing Your Vote: The Inside Story of the 2020 Election and What it Means for 2024.” Her second book, “Defiant: Inside the Mar-a-Lago Raid and the Left's Ongoing Lawfare” was released in 2025.

Peter,

I wanted you to hear this from me directly: **I'm excited to announce that Congresswoman Gwen Graham has agreed to serve alongside me as Florida's next Lieutenant Governor.**

I couldn't be more proud. And if you're as fired up about this as I am, I'm asking you to [split a donation with us and Blue Amp Action right now to help us launch this ticket the right way.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14475?t=10&source={%&akid=2878%2E259176%2Evt0h-5 include_tmpl
custom_fields.mailing_source_code %})

Here's why this matters so much to me. Gwen and I served together in the House of Representatives, and I saw up close the kind of leader she is. We didn't just sit in the same room. We worked, side by side, on the issues that actually change people's lives. When we tell you we know how to get things done together, it's because we already have.

Gwen and I are aligned on the fights that matter most to Florida families:

We're going to take on the affordability crisis that's squeezing every household in this state, from housing to insurance to the cost of getting by.

We're going to expand health care access, because no Floridian should have to choose between seeing a doctor and paying the bills.

We're going to fight for our public schools. Education has been Gwen's life's work, and with her at my side, Florida's kids and teachers will finally have a champion in the governor's office.

And we're going to confront the gun violence that has taken too many Floridians and shattered too many families. Enough.

This is what a real partnership looks like. Two people who've done the work, who trust each other, and who are ready to bring change to Tallahassee.

**But here's the truth: a strong ticket isn't enough on its own. We're building a coalition to win this year, Democrats, Independents, and Republicans ready for something better, and a coalition like that runs on grassroots support. Yours.**

I want to explain how campaigns actually work, because it matters far more than most of the fundraising deadlines you hear about. Television time gets bought months in advance. The main House Republican super PAC booked its fall advertising back in the spring. They reserved $153 million worth of ads across the country, the biggest initial reservation in the group's history. Nearly $7 million of that is already reserved against me here in Southwest Washington. And that's just one Republican group. Donald Trump's MAGA Inc. is sitting on more than $400 million. Elon Musk has authorized at least $100 million in spending to help Republicans this fall. These aren't numbers someone made up for a fundraising email. This is money that already exists. And Republicans know exactly which races they need to win. **And I’m at the top of their list. **So when millions of dollars in attacks start running against me this fall, we can't wait until then to figure out how we'll respond. The money to answer them needs to already be sitting in our account. I know this is not the most exciting email I could send you. But I'd rather tell you how this actually works than pretend every fundraising deadline is an emergency. Here's the hard part. The Speaker of the House came to Southwest Washington last month to raise money for my opponent. He told the room this district will help decide who controls the House. He's right about that. They know exactly what this seat is worth, and they budgeted for it a long time ago. I don't have a super PAC. I've never taken corporate PAC money. What I have is people chipping in $5 and $10. And our biggest advantage right now is time. If we build the resources now, we can respond when it matters instead of watching millions of dollars in attacks hit the air while we scramble to catch up. clean_body: | It's Michele Tafoya, and you need to hear about what happened. I was on the ground for a professional women's basketball game recently, and it's astonishing to me how this has become ground zero for the Left's latest culture wars. I heard firsthand, Leftist activists shouting obscene remarks at women, simply for saying that men don't belong in girls' sports. | As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene. I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend. When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way. But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different. That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field. And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work. Women's sports should belong to women. If you can agree with me on that, then I have a feeling we'll be aligned on plenty of other things. Unfortunately, my far-Left candidate is not the same. She supports biological men in girls' sports, taxpayer-funded surgeries, and largely prefers lunacy over common sense. | Thanks for all that you do. Your support does not go unnoticed. Be brave. Do good. - Michele The Minnesota Senate polls are TIED when voters learn the TRUTH about Minnesota's fraud scandal! I'm not surprised. There isn't a single American who is pro-fraud. name: Al Franken
subject: The “Powwow” Story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Gizhiiwewidamookwe, means ‘speaks in a loud and clear voice woman.’
| Dear supporter,

I want to tell you about someone who’s unbelievably great. Someone who understands what’s at stake in this moment, who listens, who leads, and who embodies the values that make Minnesota, well, _Minnesotan_. That person is Peggy Flanagan. And she’s running to represent our great state in the U.S. Senate. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=6&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf) I’ve known Peggy for a long time. We both grew up in St. Louis Park (not at the same time — she’s young, and I’m old). Raised by a single mom, Peggy knows the impact of federal programs that help working families. They had a home because of a Section 8 housing voucher. Other public programs helped her mom afford health insurance and child care. **She gets it because she’s lived it.** And that’s exactly the kind of leader we need in Washington. (And frankly, what we have way too little of.) | [HELP ELECT PEGGY TO THE SENATE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=7&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
---
Peggy’s got the experience, too. She’s currently serving as Minnesota’s Lieutenant Governor — the highest-ranking Native American woman ever elected to executive office in the U.S. Before that, she was a state legislator, a school board member, an executive director for the Children’s Defense Fund–Minnesota, she even worked for ME!

But most importantly — she worked for my friend and hero, the late Senator Paul Wellstone. She and I both believe in his guiding principle: _We all do better when we all do better._ (Yes, it’s that simple. No, Republicans still don’t get it.)

While Republicans are hiding from their constituents, Peggy is doing the opposite. She’s traveling the state hosting ‘Kitchen Table Conversations’ — actually listening to _real_ Minnesotans, having real conversations, and working to bring people together. She doesn't just want to fight against bad stuff. She wants to build something, too.

Oh, and in case you’re wondering — yes, Peggy will be the first Native American woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate. It’s about time. She is Ojibwe and a member of White Earth, and her Anishinaabe name, Gizhiiwewidamookwe, means ‘speaks in a loud and clear voice woman.’ If there’s one thing I know about Peggy, it’s that she’ll use that voice to fight for all Minnesotans — whether they agree with her or not.

[So let’s make it happen. Split a donation with the Voter Protection Project today, and help send Peggy Flanagan to the Senate, where she’ll keep speaking up, fighting hard, and making sure we all have a good hotdish recipe.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125256?t=8&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Peggy Flanagan and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125257?t=9&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125258?t=10&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125259?t=11&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125260?t=12&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125261?t=13&akid=27869%2E878179%2Ex5k8Rf)
Al

P.S. I could go on and on about how great Peggy is. But instead, let me share a quick story from my first Senate campaign in 2008. I looked at the numbers. Your file is empty. Let's fix that right now.

Friend,

I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like -- and I know what a gap looks like.

Right now, your file has a gap.

_**[The 2026 Republican Policy Assessment is still sitting incomplete — and that is the one thing I need you to fix before tonight.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/om_LMusCmkPUjaJjRxehUBQmnu41NsWHntJaz233X5ADzTVkadcctZW7VHOwNHpMbx2g-lG1r47wU4zpbNXE7QlmYGLYGISsG2Dn5QPd50ZqrHtvEOI0V7gGJdGhISaSoRPl4b_3kq9PzhLheO6XB1EjeU_YumGjc2xQ2PqP4LZQDSlD9GimCsyAalq7v-jHLTcCub65sYLJmN3hAxLvCU0PIi0mPxAdRmiiBvHj-KfOVpIbxbSz2vhvjuOZcwMABnS4P-_AGdBrGVIIi5safUpfBHnQw2Qh13oK3SvMzwnWIrfofRQRXQFwLkZbZke_HTw7bd45O9YxsedtCeTHVv2GoT_of82J3NuvDhYC0JbGvUchreUxNXSy5QSBATo9mo5uf7B3TVNLz5DdAVnQt_frg5S06iN4wTJHwBta182rQvGlbVQAxRkpgl-L1bhxm2IddMwy9thWufEIUPzx3JJhbA8djVxeh67sPRzvt99PIsxHWpu-YavGlcCgFjfEZILaAZx2esmGcirwBjqM7aq2Qx9E1EQWCg29e1FSjCEHMefQVa-ge3Wck5yJ_vTsELlIZUIJIi5gTwMEEZ2vSasXbki2_Y3bu9H0kQMfqeqs-3vdzF0v1DrTO-MZIAd_E6_c_rP7ltDx-SlmLzAIV4XwXa-6XQXjdZjbjfKtDoCcy_QKea8llK_67XFTMU8GjGEqcW4wEQPwhJUhJMBworPkYDUasBlbz-oc5_FLP7vIldO9RDerqWkwfJTGBM6S_pc22KJ8nNPdRpUKkYEW5mbpvScSYifPiJle-WcJMxM0I5UzzkRPokciGAxhR2SsYMKI01oCwpf2EPfGghxapCn2JKxMLPBU_uT23igfsAlaUJ8WvGF34t0mtjK8_dIU9TNhEN6jzpm0ADTNeI5byh93dEljvWpLhb5p82HBbvMIlvRe7t9SCgUrUbqWJzXkztjaIgSYEAcoC1oumLHEpq4f6fLN9jOMXhHU3TiefrUMdjATnnkDOSgeFsKKSIrt9fHh8BuAFQ/IYquCbv8gS-R4vlRPKVITyvE3viu7sZX/23)**_

Here's why this matters more than you might think.

When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line.

Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run -- and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer.
